t: A tiny, very cheap RISC-V chip for small gadgets and learning.
steps: Buy a WCH CH32V006 evaluation board from Olimex or a WeAct Mini Core board online.
Get a WCH-LinkE programmer. Most CH32V006 boards need one.
Download the open ch32fun SDK and a RISC-V compiler on your computer.
Connect the programmer to the board's debug pin, power and ground.
Build the blink example from ch32fun and flash it with the minichlink tool.
Watch the LED blink. On the official board, add the LED jumpers first.
Try the Arduino IDE with the WCH Arduino core for a friendlier path.
